metaDescription: Sign in to Tafiyar Uwa, a fictional maternal care demonstration in Gombe State.

login.headline: Maternal care in Gombe
login.intro: Try the Gombe clinic demo as a mother, health worker, hospital provider or administrator.
login.staffDescription: Use the account assigned to you at your facility.
login.motherDescription: Use the Maternal ID and PIN you received from your health worker.
login.maternalIdHint: MC- followed by six letters or numbers.
login.demoGuideDescription: Ask the person running the demo for the password or PIN that goes with one of these accounts.

dashboard.name: Name
dashboard.adminIntro: View the facilities and staff taking part in the Gombe demo.
dashboard.workerIntro: Register a mother or open her record to enter a clinic visit.
dashboard.providerIntro: Check which hospital your account belongs to.
dashboard.motherIntro: Keep your Maternal ID for your next visit.
dashboard.sharedDevice: Sign out when you finish using a shared device.

security.origin: This request could not be verified. Return to the app and try again.
security.tooLarge: This request is too large. Check your details and try again.
security.invalidForm: Enter your sign-in details and try again.
security.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
security.invalidCredentials: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your details or try again in a few minutes.
security.forbidden: Your account does not have access to this page.
security.serverError: We couldn’t complete your request. Please try again.

care.name: Mother’s name
care.registrationIntro: Use fictional details only. Give the mother her Maternal ID after registration.
care.consent: The mother agrees that other participating clinics may view her record.
care.consentHint: She can register and receive care here if she leaves this unchecked.
care.openHint: Enter the Maternal ID to record a visit at your health centre. Opening the record is logged.
care.registered: Mother registered. Give her the Maternal ID shown here. She can sign in with it and her PIN.
care.previousHint: These dates were set at earlier visits.
care.noAppointment: No next appointment has been set.
care.noAppointmentHint: Ask your health worker for the date of your next visit.

provider.lookupIntro: Ask the mother for her Maternal ID. You can view her record if she has agreed to share it.
provider.reasonHint: Briefly describe why you need this record. Your name, facility and reason will appear in the access log.
provider.offlineNotice: This saved copy shows what was recorded when you last opened the record online.
provider.offlineReady: Offline copy ready on this device.
provider.offlineUnavailable: An offline copy is unavailable on this device.
provider.offlineCleared: Saved copy removed from this device.
provider.auditIntro: See who requested each record, why they needed it and whether they gained access. Times are shown in Gombe local time.
provider.auditEmpty: No record openings have been logged on this page.
provider.invalidId: Enter a Maternal ID in the format MC-XXXXXX.
provider.invalidReason: Give a reason between 3 and 500 characters long.
provider.unavailable: This record is unavailable. Check the Maternal ID with the mother.
provider.forbidden: Your account cannot open this record.
provider.invalidEvent: This offline access could not be recorded.

offline.title: Saved record
offline.checking: Checking this tab for a saved record.
offline.enableJavaScript: Turn on JavaScript to view a saved record.
offline.unavailable: No saved record is available in this tab.
offline.auditBlocked: Reconnect to upload the access log before opening this record.

simulator.title: Basic-phone simulator
simulator.intro: Explore the appointment menu a basic phone could offer.
simulator.simulationHint: This demo runs in your browser. Live USSD and SMS are planned for a later phase.
simulator.signIn: Enter your Maternal ID and PIN
simulator.loginHint: Use the same Maternal ID and PIN you use for your appointment page.
simulator.menu: What would you like to check?
simulator.visitTip: Regular antenatal visits help your health worker spot problems early. Before you leave the clinic, ask when to come back.
simulator.foodTip: Try to eat a variety of foods you can get locally, including beans, leafy vegetables and fruit. At your next visit, ask which foods fit your needs and budget.
simulator.foodSource: WHO guidance on food during pregnancy
simulator.tipReview: Discuss this information with your health worker.
simulator.motherOnly: Sign out of your staff account to try the simulator with a mother's Maternal ID and PIN.

reminder.title: Reminder outbox
reminder.intro: Create a reminder for the appointment saved at the latest visit.
reminder.simulationHint: Reminders are saved here as a simulation. SMS delivery is planned for a later phase.
reminder.message: You have an appointment on {date}. Please contact your health worker if you need help.
reminder.queued: Reminder saved to the simulation outbox.
reminder.duplicate: This reminder is already in the simulation outbox.
reminder.empty: No reminders have been saved yet.
reminder.forbidden: Your account cannot access these reminders.
reminder.unavailable: This record is unavailable at your health centre.
reminder.invalidRequest: Reopen the record and try again.
reminder.noAppointment: Save a next appointment at the latest visit before creating a reminder.
reminder.pastAppointment: This appointment date has passed. Save the next appointment before creating a reminder.
reminder.conflict: This request has already been used for another reminder. Reopen the record and try again.

careErrors.notFound: No record with that ID is available at your health centre.
careErrors.duplicateRequest: This form has already been submitted with different details. Open a fresh form to start again.
careErrors.idUnavailable: A Maternal ID could not be created. Please try again.
careErrors.invalidName: Enter a name within the allowed length.
careErrors.invalidAge: Enter an age in whole years, from 0 to 120.
careErrors.invalidPin: Choose a PIN of 8 to 12 digits.
careErrors.pinMismatch: The two PINs must match. Enter them again.
careErrors.invalidRequest: Reopen the form and try again.
careErrors.invalidNumber: Check the measurement and its format.
careErrors.invalidPressure: Enter two numbers separated by a slash, such as 120/80.
careErrors.futureVisit: The visit date cannot be later than today.
careErrors.appointmentBeforeVisit: Choose an appointment date on or after the visit date.
